question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

Earwax is a helpful and ______ part of your body's defenses.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e.** 'Natural'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct option** to fill in the blank in the sentence "Earwax is a helpful and ______ part of your body's defenses." is option 4:** "natural".**
 
• **"Natural" **means existing in or derived from nature; not made or caused by humankind.
 
• **It fits well **in the context of this sentence because earwax is a natural product of the human body. (प्राकृतिक)

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'Earwax is a helpful and **natural** part of your body's defenses.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are explanations for all the options:

 
 
• **Transparent:** This refers to something that allows light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.(पारदर्शी)
 
• **Flowing:** This describes something that moves along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream. (बहता हुआ)
 
• **Tedious:** This means too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous. (नीरस)
